ministry: Department of Skill Development, Entrepreneurship and Livelihood, Government of Karnataka
benefits_summary: Monthly unemployment allowance of ₹3,000 for unemployed degree graduates and ₹1,500 for unemployed diploma holders for up to 2 years alongside free skill training.
exclusions: Individuals already employed in public or private sector or self-employed with Mudra/state loans
Non-domiciles of Karnataka (must have studied at least 6 years in Karnataka)
documents_required: SSLC / 10th and PUC Marks Cards (showing 6 years study in Karnataka)
application_steps: Log into the Karnataka Seva Sindhu Guarantee Schemes Portal (sevasindhugs.karnataka.gov.in).
Fill out the Yuva Nidhi application with your University Registration Number for NAD verification.
Submit monthly self-declaration of unemployment status before the 25th of each month.
